identity_split.trigger: Multiple Local IDs from different sources pointing to the same SPU.
identity_split.rule: Preserve all Local IDs. Map to single Unified ID. Never force ERP change.
identity_split.conflict_handling: Flag for audit. Do not auto-merge.

permission_rules.authorization_atom: SPU is mandatory atomic unit. No exceptions.
permission_rules.sku_policy: SKU = child attribute. Inherits from SPU. Cannot be independent authorization unit.
permission_rules.access_control: Filter at DB query level by User Role.
permission_rules.visibility: Shared does not mean fully open. Supplier controls visibility.
permission_rules.request_rule: Request does not mean automatic access. Supplier owns release decision.

secondary_processing.definition: Material + Material = New Material / New SmartPN
